rubric.role_summary: Senior systems engineering role owning the architecture, definition, integration, and validation of a robotic defense system from concept through field deployment.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior systems engineering role owning the architecture, definition, integration, and validation of a robotic defense system from concept through field deployment.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years of systems engineering experience within robotics, aerospace, or defense.
- MSc in Engineering, in any field.
- Background in system architecture, requirements engineering, and trade-off analysis.
- Understanding of mechanical, electrical, and embedded systems.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- PhD.
- Experience with UAS or defense systems.
- Experience leading full system lifecycles from concept through prototype and validation.
- Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and managing technical interfaces.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Rabat area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
